The black hole in a corner of the universe is the trash. Press / or Ctrl+K for the cluster list, searchable by cluster, group or member name. Drag to turn the view, scroll to zoom (all the way in enters, all the way out goes back), double-click empty space to reset, Esc goes up a level, F shows the frame rate.
